## Draft-to-review checklist

Complete before requesting full review. Explain non-applicable items; missing required evidence is not a pass. See the [canonical review gate](https://github.com/GoodDollar/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#3-open-a-draft-then-pass-the-review-gate).

- [ ] The work was assigned, follows the approved scope and meets acceptance criteria.
- [ ] PR title follows `(Feature|Bug|Chore) Task Name`; I reviewed my changes and followed repository conventions.
- [ ] I tested the result myself and attached proof, including manual-flow evidence.
- [ ] Required automated QA, regression tests, lint, type checks and builds pass without new warnings.
- [ ] UI/UX was compared with the reference; reference-vs-result screenshots and a happy-path video cover relevant desktop/mobile behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, and known limitations and untested areas are stated.
- [ ] Maintainers requested Copilot review; it completed and I responded with fixes, questions or evidence-backed counterpoints.
- [ ] The bounty lead confirmed these checks in this PR before Ready for review or reviewer assignment.
